_comment: The Paddle Down food menu, transcribed from the October 2026 menu PDF. Prices are plain numbers as the printed menu has them, no currency mark. This menu carries no dietary markers, so `diet` is absent throughout and the legend renders empty on its own — renderLegend only emits codes actually used. Optional `notice` renders a banner in the hero; delete the field once there is nothing to announce and the banner disappears.
title: Paddle Down
intro: Chef-driven plates, loaded baskets and everything in between — served courtside or at the bar.

notes: Ask your server about the bar list: courtside cocktails, wine, draft beer and zero-proof.
Consuming raw or under-cooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish or eggs may increase your risk of food-borne illness.
Before placing your order, please inform your server if a person in your party has a food allergy.
